C-cebreak-01: diagnosed, not a bench-glue fault: the suite's trap prolog (riscv-arch-test README, target requirement 1) needs a fully writable mtvec. CVE2 forces mtvec = {base[31:8], 6'b0, MODE=2'b01}, so the prolog's read-back never equals its trampoline address and it falls back to copying the 16-word trampoline over the reset mtvec value, using that raw value (0x80000001, MODE bit included) as a word pointer. The copy lands one byte off, 0x80000000 holds 0x00006f00, and c.ebreak vectors into a fetch loop at 0x80000000..0x80000008 so tohost is never written. See spec/decisions/0011-c-cebreak-01-mtvec-not-writable.md.
